scope: Explicit 18-group toolbar requirements of 2026-10-25. Distinct buttons have distinct glyphs, not generic icon plus label substitution. Frozen source audit remains unchanged.
integration_policy: Use these specific IDs for the listed toolbar choices before older generic command-bindings.json mappings. Generic menu icons remain available. This JSON is declarative metadata, not code deployed into consumers. Active state, accessible names and tooltips are still required.
limitations: pdxadv, cnc-sim and cax-cable-sim consumer routes not inspected in this assigned Studio/viewer audit.
BIM exact object-route integration not established.
Catalog additions do not mean consumer imports/buttons have been changed.

bindings.reason: Release an imported source to make its bodies independently editable; source names, layers and drawings are dropped, while Undo can restore them.
